infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius.text: If the player does not have all of the requirements to start the quest:
If the player has all of the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Nilsal, my child. Your arrival is well timed.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Yes. The Queen would like to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Indeed. She is waiting for you upstairs. I will go on ahead and let her know you are here.
A cutscene opens with the player meeting with the council.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: I am told you were with my son when he was captured?

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: You followed along with this plan of his, knowing that in doing so, you were supporting him in disobeying an order from his Queen?

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: You do not strike me as a fool, so why do you play the part of one?

steps.player: I can fix this. I promise you, I will find Itzla and I will rescue him.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Why should I trust you? Because my son did? Tell me, which recent event was it that suggested to you that he was of sound judgement?

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: With respect, my Queen, were it not for [player name] here, I would have died at the hands of the Emissaries. I believe [he has/she has/they have] earned our trust.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Trust is like a blade. If not maintained, it fails when you need it most.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Then let us give our iknami here the opportunity to regain our trust.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: You seem to have made quite the impression, outsider. Both Servius and my son have taken a liking to you.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Prove them right. Rectify this situation.

steps.player: I will. Where should I begin?

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: We need to avoid outright aggression. The safety of my son cannot be risked. I understand you were able to infiltrate the Emissaries and gain access to their temple?

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Then do so again. Gather any information you can on what they are doing with my son, then return to me here. Do not give me a reason to regret this decision.

steps.player: I won't let you down. You have my word.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Good luck, my child. May the sun light your way.
The cutscene ends, teleporting the player upstairs of the Sunrise Palace.

steps.player: I just need to do something else first, but I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Don't take too long. The Queen doesn't like to be kept waiting.

infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.text: The Queen is waiting, my child. Let us go and speak with her.

infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.text: Nilsal, my child. I wish you luck at the Twilight Temple.

infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.player: Thank you. We'll have Itzla back soon. I promise.

infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.text: You have the dedication of a true servant of Ralos. Keep safe, my child.

infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
infiltration-ii-talking-to-servius-talki.text: You have a job to do. Return to the Twilight Temple and uncover any information you may have missed when you were last there.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-twilight-te.text: If the player is not wearing the emissary robes:

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Hey! You don't have permission to go in there!

infiltration-ii-entering-the-twilight-te.text: If the player is wearing the emissary robes:

steps.text: A cutscene opens with Metzli leading a sermon.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: ... and with the guidance of Ralos and Ranul, who stand beside us in our fight, we will be victorious!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: I know recent setbacks have you questioning. I know you have concerns. You need not whisper them in the shadows, for you are free to question. More than that, you are encouraged to question!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: After all, was it not your questions that brought you here? Did you not dare to ask them while others shied away in fear?

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Remember this: We are the doubters! We are the outcasts! Society shunned us for it, but only those who question everything will ever find the truth.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: And that truth? That is what we fight for. That is what will bring about the Final Dawn!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Let me now assure you, these setbacks have done nothing to stop us! The road to Mokhaiotl is clearer than ever! We have no need for the Teokan any more!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Bring out the prisoner!
An Emissary Ascended brings out Prince Itzla, stripped of clothing.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: See how the rulers of this kingdom are powerless against us. Itzla Arkan, heir to the throne of Varlamore, is now our prisoner!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: You love it, don't you? Standing on a stage spouting nonsense to a bunch of fanatics! It means nothing, Metzli!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: People like you always fear the truth. Do you know why? Because without your lies, all that you do, all that you live for, is meaningless.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: But your fear, it can now end. Here, you finally have a purpose. Here, you can finally serve Ralos and Ranul.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Do you not see? The blood of the Teokan runs through your veins. You are now the key to the Final Dawn!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: You want my blood? Take it! Just make sure you take it all! At least that way I won't have to listen to the garbage you spew any more!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Listen to the anger in his voice. It is a poor attempt to mask his fear. We need not fear though, for our purpose is clear.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Go now, for time is short, and there is much left to do. It will soon be time to deliver Twilight's Promise. It will soon be time for the Final Dawn!
The cutscene ends as Itzla is taken away.

steps.player: Hmm... They brought Itzla in from downstairs...

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: The people of this world do not have the strength to do what must be done. Ximoua will only come to be if we make it so.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Greetings, friend. Our time grows ever near. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all as one, and we will create a new world.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: It is an honour to serve the Augur. She will lead us to Mokhaiotl.

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: The Final Dawn approaches, friend. We will deliver Twilight's Promise.

infiltration-ii-attempting-to-climb-down.speaker: Emissary Ascended
infiltration-ii-attempting-to-climb-down.text: I can't let you down there without the passphrase.

steps.text: If the selected phrase was not "Final Dawn":

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Nice try. Only those worthy to know the passphrase may enter.
If the selected phrase was "Final Dawn":

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: Correct!

steps.speaker: Emissary Ascended
steps.text: That's right. Go right ahead.

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: This area is off limits to you!

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: This is the restricted section!

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: You're not allowed to be here!

infiltration-ii-getting-caught-by-the-en.text: A guard spots you in a restricted area and kicks you out.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: A cutscene plays in which the player enters the backroom.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.player: There must be something useful here...

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: The player walks into the northern room.
The sound of a door opening is heard.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Furia Tullus
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: ... not to mention what happens when the Queen sends her forces to recover the Prince.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Augur Metzli
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: The Queen will not dare put her son in danger. Your worries are unfounded. Besides, I've already made arrangements for him to be moved elsewhere.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Furia Tullus
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: Unfounded? Do you not see how risky this plan is? We should have stuck with Servius rather than revealing ourselves.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Augur Metzli
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: And if the opportunity presents itself, Servius will still make for a valid option. The trick here isn't to have one plan, it's to have many. We have enough options available that one of them will bear fruit.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Furia Tullus
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: It won't matter how many options we have if we don't live long enough to see them through. You keep gambling with our future here!

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Augur Metzli
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: You should have more faith, Furia. Look at your brother. He's a true believer now.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Furia Tullus
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: A fool is what he is.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.speaker: Augur Metzli
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom.text: Good job we have many uses for fools then...

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: You search the bed and find a key under one of the pillows.
You search the bed and find a key under one of the pillows, but you don't have enough room to take it.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-op.text: You use the key you found to unlock the drawers.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: You search the drawers and find a piece of canvas.
You search the drawers and find a piece of canvas, but you don't have enough room to take it.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-us.text: You place the piece of canvas into the painting and you hear a click as you do so.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-us.prompt: There looks to be a passage behind the painting.

steps.text: You go through the passage and find yourself in a hidden room.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: You picklock the chest and find a scroll inside.
A cutscene begins. The player is about to leave the backroom, only to be intercepted by the Emissary Enforcer.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: What is this? No one is allowed in here!
The guard confiscates the scroll you found in the hidden room.

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: There's only one outcome for betraying the Augur...
The cutscene begins. The player fights the Emissary Enforcer.

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: Traitor!

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: Thief!

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: Face me!

steps.speaker: Emissary Enforcer
steps.text: You can't escape me!

infiltration-ii-entering-the-backroom-se.text: You already have the scroll from this chest.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: You've returned. I trust that means you have news for us?

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.player: I do. Itzla was being held at the temple, but they've now moved him elsewhere.
I don't know, but I did also find out that they have some sort of plan for him. They called him the key to the Final Dawn. Something to do with him having Servius' blood.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: My blood? Do they wish to trigger the Gathering?

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: What it is isn't important right now. Do not lose focus on the matter at hand. If you don't know where they took my son, then how do you intend to find out?

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.player: I discovered that Forebearer Janus, a senior member of the Emissaries, is living right here in Fortis in a cult safe house. I was thinking we could capture him and find out what he knows.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Well, there are no houses opposite the eastern bank, so it must be the one looking over the western bank.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Then let's not waste any time. Adventurer, I will dispatch Captain Vibia of the Knights of Varlamore to this property. You will meet her there. Secure the property with her and capture this Forebearer Janus.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.player: I'll head over there at once.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Good. May the sun light your way.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Nilsal, my child. The Queen has given you a job to do. I suggest you get going. Keep safe out there.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Adventurer, you should head to this cultist property near the western bank. Captain Vibia will meet you there.

home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-talking-to-queen-zyanyi-or.text: Good. May the sun light your way.

home-invasion-attempting-to-open-the-saf.text: The guard dog doesn't take kindly to your presence.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.text: Good, you're here. Shall we get started?

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.text: I've been observing the property and it doesn't seem anyone is home. At least, not any people...

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.text: Dogs. There's one outside and at least one more in the house. I don't expect them to take kindly to intruders.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.text: We will secure the house and prepare a trap to capture this cultist leader upon their return. As we don't know exactly when that will be, I suggest we move quickly.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia.text: First up, we need a way inside. I will keep watch out here while you find us that way in.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia-t.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia-t.text: We're wasting time here. You need to find a way into this house.

home-invasion-inspecting-the-north-windo.text: The window seems to be locked tight.

home-invasion-inspecting-the-south-windo.prompt: The wooden cover over the window appears to be loose.

steps.text: You manage to force open the window cover. Inside the room you see a dog roaming around.

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones.text: The dog takes the bones and then licks your hand in return.

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-givin.text: The dog takes Alan's bones. Something doesn't feel quite right about this, but the dog seems happy enough. He quickly calms down and gives your hand a little lick.

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-talki.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-talki.text: That cultist could be back at any time. What's the hold up?

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-talki.player: I've found a way into the house, but there's a locked door I need to get past. I'll have it open soon.

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-talki.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-talki.text: Good. Best you get back to it then.

home-invasion-giving-the-dog-bones-petti.text: You pet the dog and notice his name tag as you do so.

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.text: You unlock the door and call in Captain Vibia to join you.

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.text: Good work. Now that the property is secure, we need to prepare for the return of this Forebearer Janus. I trust you brought supplies?

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.text: First, we'll need a way to restrain him.

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.player: Hmm... I don't think I have anything suitable on me.

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.text: Well, what about something to knock him out with?

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.player: I don't think I have anything for that either. Shall I head out and gather some things?

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse.text: No. This cultist could be back at any moment and we need to make sure we're here when he does. Let's have a look around and see if there's anything in the house we can use instead.

options.text: So you're a Knight of Varlamore?

steps.player: So you're a Knight of Varlamore?

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: I am. What of it?

steps.player: That makes Itzla your boss, right?

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: He is the leader of the Knights of Varlamore, though I am currently filling that role in his absense.

steps.player: What do you think of this whole situation with him?

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: I think we have a job to do, and I think we should get on with it rather than making small talk.

home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse-talking.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-in-janus-safehouse-talking.text: We need to prepare for the return of this Forebearer Janus. We'll need a way to restrain him and something to knock him out with. Let's have a look around and see if there's anything here we can use.

options.text: So you're a Knight of Varlamore?

home-invasion-inspecting-the-potted-fan.text: This plant doesn't seem to be quite as healthy as the others. It has a few dead branches sprouting from it.

home-invasion-using-a-bucket-on-the-pott.text: The soil seems too solid for you to scoop any up with that.

home-invasion-using-the-empty-coin-purse.text: The soil seems too solid for you to scoop any up with that.

steps.text: You go to cut a dead branch from the plant, but realise you don't have room to hold it.
You cut a dead branch from the plant.

home-invasion-using-a-knife-on-the-potte.text: You've already cut a dead branch from the plant.

home-invasion-using-the-branch-on-the-po.text: You can't just attach a branch back to a plant again.

home-invasion-using-the-empty-coin-purse.text: You might be able to combine these into a decent enough blackjack if the purse were more sturdy somehow.

home-invasion-inspecting-the-plant-pot.text: This plant pot has been filled with sand.

home-invasion-using-a-bucket-on-the-plan.text: You fill the bucket with sand from the plant pot.

home-invasion-using-a-bucket-of-sand-on-.text: The bucket is already full of sand.

home-invasion-using-the-empty-coin-purse.text: You fill the coin purse with sand from the plant pot.

home-invasion-using-the-sandy-coin-purse.text: The coin purse is already full of sand.

home-invasion-emptying-the-coin-purse.text: You empty the sand from the coin purse.

home-invasion-using-the-branch-on-the-sa.text: You bind the sand-filled purse to the end of the springy branch, creating a makeshift blackjack.

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: You show the rope to Captain Vibia.
If the player has not yet given Captain Vibia an empty sack:

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Hmm... I guess we could use this to restrain him, but I reckon we'll instead want something that can cover his head as well.

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: If the player has already given Captain Vibia an empty sack:

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: No. I think that sack you gave me will be better for restraining him with.

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: You show the blackjack to Captain Vibia.
If the player has not yet given Captain Vibia a makeshift blackjack:

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: That thing looks brutal! We don't want to kill him!

steps.player: You mean this thing could kill a person?

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Quite possibily!

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: If the player has already given Captain Vibia a makeshift blackjack:

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: That thing looks brutal! We don't want to kill him! Maybe you should use that other one you made instead.

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: You show the coin purse to Captain Vibia.

home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-showing-captain-vibia-vari.text: Very nice, but I'm not sure what use it has.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia-2.text: The player has an empty sack in their inventory:

steps.text: You give the sack to Captain Vibia.

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Yes, I think I can use this to restrain him with. I'll keep a hold of it.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia-2.text: The player has a branch in their inventory:

steps.text: You show the branch to Captain Vibia.

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Hmm... Not on its own, I don't think.

home-invasion-talking-to-captain-vibia-2.text: The player has the makeshift blackjack in their inventory:

steps.player: I made this from a few things I found.

steps.text: You show the makeshift blackjack to Captain Vibia.

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Perfect! You keep a hold of that and use it to subdue him when the time comes.

steps.player: I think we have everything we need now.

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: I believe you're right. Now just to wait for him to return home...
A cutscene begins. Forebearer Janus, in wealthy citizen clothing, returns to the safe house.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Good dog.

steps.speaker: Guard Dog
steps.text: Woof!
Forebearer Janus enters the safe house.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: What the...
Captain Vibia places the sack over Janus' head.

steps.speaker: Forebearer Janus
steps.text: Hey! Get this thing off me!

steps.speaker: Captain Vibia
steps.text: Whack him!
The player whacks him. The cutscene ends.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: You search Janus and find a key to the basement.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Good. Down there will work nicely for interrogation. You get him ready. I'll fetch the Queen...
A cutscene plays. Queen Zyanyi, her Kualti, and Servius arrive and gather in Janus' basement.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Forebearer Janus
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: The Queen herself? Such an honour. Don't think for one second that I'm going to tell you anything though. Even death itself doesn't scare me.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Really? I've known a lot of people claim death doesn't scare them. From afar, bravery comes easy, but then the moment finally comes when they stare death in the face...
The Queen walks toward Janus.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: That's when they break. If you think you're the exception, you will soon be disappointed.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Forebearer Janus
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Ha! You are out of touch, my Queen. I am a herald of the Final Dawn! For us, death is a glory to be celebrated!

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Then celebrate it you will, but first, you will talk.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Leave me with him. Alone.
You leave the Queen with Forebearer Janus...

As the group leaves the two of them alone, the screen fades to black while various sounds of an unarmed man being assaulted can be heard. The screen then returns to normal, with the group returning as well. Janus is lying on the ground.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: He talked.
The cutscene ends.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: It seems you were right Servius, the cultists wish to trigger the Gathering.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: Sorry, but could someone explain what the Gathering is to me?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: It's the ceremony where a dead Teokan is laid to rest and their successor is chosen.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: But why is it so important to the cultists?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: According to our recently departed iknami here, it's less about the ceremony and more about its location: The Crypt of Tonali, in the Tlati Rainforest. The cult believe the crypt houses the secret path to Mokhaiotl.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: The Tlati Rainforest? Just like the nagua said...

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Yes, Servius mentioned this nagua you encountered. What did she say?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: Not much. She just referred to Mokhaiotl as the Tlati archive.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: We should be weary of trusting the words of a nagua, my Queen.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Perhaps, though it matters little whether we believe her or not. The cult do believe, and they will stop at nothing to access the crypt.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: So what do we do now?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: The Gathering takes place behind a set of doors within the crypt. These doors can only be opened with the blood of the two Teokan.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: The cult are hoping to substitute Servius' blood with my son's, but it seems they are having issues in doing so. They have apparently chosen to seek help from the Dwarves of Cam Torum with this.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: The crypt is the most holiest of places, built by the Old Ones themselves. However, the doors were a more recent addition, built by the dwarves. This was before relations soured between us...

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.player: I see. So, to Cam Torum then?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: To Cam Torum. Oh, and [player name]...

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: You did well here. It seems Itzla was right to trust you.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus.text: Now, we will depart at once. Are you ready to go?

steps.text: A cutscene begins in which the group arrives at Cam Torum.

options.text: I'll make my own way there.

steps.player: I'll make my own way there.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Very well, but let me know if you change your mind.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.text: [player name], do you wish to travel with us to Cam Torum?

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.text: Nilsal, my child. We will soon be heading to Cam Torum. You should speak with the Queen if you wish to join us.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.text: I hear you're heading to Cam Torum. You should not waste time.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.speaker: Captain Vibia
home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.text: No. I am to head to the Tlati Rainforest and ensure we have suitable defences around the Crypt of Tonali.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.player: Makes sense. In that case, good luck.

home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.speaker: Captain Vibial
home-invasion-interrogating-janus-talkin.text: And to you, adventurer. May the sun light your way.

dwarven-traitor.text: Upon agreeing to travel to Cam Torum with Queen Zyanyi and company, a cutscene begins in which the group arrives at Cam Torum.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Zyanyi Arkan. What an unexpected surprise. Your business here must be very important for you to have not sent prior word of your coming.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: I'm afraid the suddenness of our arrival was a necessity, though I'm pleased to see that it didn't prevent you from meeting us here personally, Highlord Katlo.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Well, what kind of ruler would I be if I didn't make sure to treat our honoured allies with the highest of respect?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: How very true.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: I heard about the unfortunate events at the Teomat, but it is good to see the Teokan has made a full recovery. No doubt those responsible met swift justice?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Their days are numbered.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: So they are still at large? How concerning. Still, I'm sure your son and his knights will be doing all they can to rectify that.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Perhaps, Highlord, we should discuss the reason for our visit?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Yes, of course. What is it that brings you here?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: We have reason to believe that enemies of Varlamore are operating within Cam Torum.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Enemies of Varlamore in Cam Torum? I couldn't even begin to imagine such a thing! Are you sure of this?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Very.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Then what can you tell me of these enemies?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: They are members of the Twilight Emissaries cult. The cult wish to gain access to the Crypt of Tonali, but they require dwarven help to do so.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: I assure you, no cultist would have been granted access to the city. For a start, there are only four of us who even have the ability to grant that access.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: However, it is clear this is a matter of great importance to you. I will ensure that we keep a close eye out for any cultists.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: With respect, Highlord, these cultists are our enemy. I would ask that you let us find and deal with them personally.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: I understand, and I would very much like to help you. However, a human investigation in Cam Torum would not be looked upon kindly by the citizens here.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor.text: If I may, Highlord, the human travelling with the Queen here is a friend to us. They are the one who helped us deal with the issues in the ruins beneath the city.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor.text: If it is this human who is to be conducting the investigations here, I am sure they will act with discretion.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: You are happy to vouch for them, Attala?

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor.text: I am.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Very well. In that case, my good friends, I grant you permission to search for these cultists. Attala here will join you. Do let her know if there's anything at all that you need.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Thank you, Highlord.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor.text: Do not mention it. Dealing with Varlamorians is always such a pleasure. Now, I'm afraid I must depart, but I wish you good luck.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor.text: I will wait for you in the market, [player name]. I have some ideas for where you might begin your search.
The dwarven group take their leave,

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: So you've worked with the dwarves here before? You are full of surprises, [player name].

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Clearly. Now, time is of the essence here. Use the trust you have built with the dwarves to find and stop the cultists. Once you have done so, report to me at Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: No. My presence here will be a distraction, and I must ensure that the defences are ready at the Crypt of Tonali. However, I trust you will not let me down.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor.text: I will stay as well. It is possible my knowledge will come in useful during the investigation.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Nonsense. Need I remind you that you are still a target for the cultists? You will return to the palace.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor.text: The Emissaries hide everywhere. I am no safer at the palace than I am here.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: Fine. But I will leave a bodyguard with you.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor.text: You should not waste the Kualti on me.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
dwarven-traitor.text: No I shouldn't, and yet here we are. Now, let us get to work. Good luck to you both, and may the sun light your way.

dwarven-traitor.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor.text: Thank you, my Queen. Come, [player name], let us meet with this dwarf in the market.
The cutscene ends.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.text: Ah, good day to you, human. It's always a pleasure to have the company of your kind in our city.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.text: I'd love to stop and chat with you, but I know you're very busy. Might I suggest you seek out Attala? She'll be more than happy to help you out with your investigation.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.player: I'll go and see her now.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: When I vouched for you back there, [player name], I wasn't expecting you to bring a Teokan with you.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Hmph. Help with what exactly? You claim there are cultists in our city who want access this crypt of yours, but you haven't said why. What's so special about the crypt?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.player: They think it hides a path to Mokhaiotl.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Ah, of course they do. Don't you humans ever tire of your fantasies?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Of course not! No human can reach Mokhaiotl!

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Ha! And yet here you are trying to stop some cultists from doing just that!

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Their beliefs are false! They follow the words of a lying heathen!

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Ah, of course! A lying heathen. Just like us here, no doubt?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.player: Okay, let's put a stop to this before things get out of hand. Attala, you said you had an idea for where we could start our search?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Hmph. As the Highlord said, there are only four dwarves who can grant humans access to Cam Torum. They are myself, the Highlord, Highseer Vandra, and Teumo, Vandra's advisor.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Not exactly, but of those, Teumo is the most likely candidate. I trust the Highlord and the Highseer, and I know for a fact it wasn't me.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.player: Let's start with Teumo then. Where can we find him?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: His house is the one behind the bank, east of here. Let us meet there.
Attala and Servius depart for Teumo's home.

dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.text: ... and that he should be back soon. Why do you need to see him anyway, Attala? And how come you have a human priest with you?

dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.text: Believe me, the priest wasn't my choice.

dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.text: Anyway, don't worry yourself, Galna. It's not an urgent matter by any means. It's just a little project that Teumo was working on that needs finishing off.

dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.text: Speaking of which, do you mind if we take a look around while we wait for him? I imagine he'll have left some things from his project here.

dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-entering-teumo-s-home.text: Oh, I suppose so. Do keep out of the basement though. Teumo doesn't like people going down there.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.text: Is there anything we can get for you while we wait, Galna? Given we came barging in on you, it's the least we can do.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.text: Oh, thank you, but I'm fine.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.text: Very tempting, but I shouldn't really start drinking at this time...

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-or-gal.text: Nilsal, my child. Perhaps there is something here that can be of use to us. You should have a look around.

dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna.player: Are you sure you wouldn't fancy a drink?

dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna.text: Well, I guess it would be rude to say no...
You give the beer to Galna. She takes a sip before quickly chugging the rest down.

dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna-talk.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna-talk.text: Thanks again for letting us look around, Galna.

dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna-talk.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-using-beer-on-galna-talk.text: Not at all! My home is yours. Go wherever you want!

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Teumo must have had a reason for not wanting people down here. Let's find out what it is.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-attala-in-the.text: The puzzle is solved but the lever has not been pulled:

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Interesting... Whatever you did caused the fire to go out...

options.text: So what's your take on this Mokhaiotl business?

steps.player: So what's your take on this Mokhaiotl business?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Well, just so I'm understanding correctly, there's a cult who believe there is a path to the centre of the world?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: And what do they intend to do once they get there?

steps.player: They're claiming that two of the cultists are Ralos and Ranul reborn. They believe that once the two of them reach Mokhaiotl, the world will be destroyed and then remade once more.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Of course! What a totally normal thing to believe. Only humans would ever manage to reach this level of silliness.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Do not tar us all with the same brush. Most humans would never believe the nonsense those cultists spread.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: No, you just believe a different nonsense. I must admit, to those of us who live in the real world, it can sometimes be hard to tell the difference.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Anyway, as for my take, your cultists are going to end up disappointed. There is no Mokhaiotl. The only path they will find is one leading to their deaths.

steps.player: And yet, it isn't just them who have spoken of it.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: What are you on about?

steps.player: I encountered a nagua who called Mokhaiotl an archive.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Really? How curious... Hard to know what that might mean though. Nagua are not known for being reliable.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Ah, something we agree on.

steps.player: So you don't think she was telling the truth?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: The truth isn't something that ever seems to matter to your kind. This cult has already made up their minds on what they believe, just as your priest here has as well.

steps.player: But I'm not asking them. I'm asking you. What do you believe?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: That Ralos doesn't exist. That Ranul doesn't exist. That Mokhaiotl doesn't exist. It's as simple as that. Now, if that answer satisfies you, shall we get back to work?

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Nilsal, my child. Perhaps there is something here that can be of use to us. You should have a look around and see what you can find.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Nilsal, my child. It looks like you're making progress. Keep at it.

options.text: If it's okay to ask, what's the deal with you and the Queen?

steps.player: If it's okay to ask, what's the deal with you and the Queen?

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: How do you mean, my child?

steps.player: Well, you're Itzla's father and she's his mother, but the two of you don't seem too close.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: We are incredibly close, for we are united in Ralos' light, and in the love we share for Itzla. However, it would be fair to say that our relationship is not a conventional one, especially to an outsider.

steps.player: So how did it come about?

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: In times of old, the ruler of Varlamore would often unite with a Teokan of Ralos. His light guides us in all things, and a King or Queen will need that guidance more than most.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Before she took the throne, the Queen made the decision to revive that old tradition. I was more than happy to accept.

steps.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
steps.text: Do not mention it, my child.
