dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: A cutscene begins, with the Tullus twins in a nearby cavern.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Must we wear these nasty things?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: They're called disguises, brother.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: We shouldn't have need to disguise ourselves. We shouldn't be here at all. This dwarf can't be trusted.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: If you have any better suggestions, I'm all ears...
Teumo arrives and approaches the twins.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Ah, there you are. Oh, I'm sorry, am I meant to bow?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: You jest, dwarf, but you should show some respect.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Yes, of course, Your... Holiness? Your Excellency? I'm sorry, I've never had the luck of meeting a god before. What is your preferred title?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Enough! Do not push me, dwarf!

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Why? You are powerless to do anything about it. Without me, you go back to your Augur empty handed. I get the feeling she wouldn't like that.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Well then it's a good thing we do not answer to her.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: No? If that's the case, then why are you doing her bidding? Of all the people she could have sent here, why did she pick her gods reborn?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: The blood of Ralos flows through my veins, dwarf! When we reach Mokhaiotl, you will see for yourself.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Ha! And what will you see? What happens when you reach the apparent centre of the world, only to discover that everything you thought you knew, was wrong?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: You think you're so...

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Calm yourself, brother. Arguing gets us nowhere. Tell us, dwarf, can it be done?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Yes, I believe so. However, it will not be straightforward.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Meaning?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: I will need you to retrieve something for me. The crypt doors are sealed using the magic of an Old One keystone. I will need one of these keystones for myself if I am to have any success.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: And where will we find one of those?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: It is a keystone that keeps the nagua imprisoned in Neypotzli. I'm sure it can't be the only one in there.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Then go in and find one for yourself. We do not serve you.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: So you claim, and yet you don't actually have a choice. If you want my help, you'll find me a keystone.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: You will have it. Just make sure you are ready.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Of course! I assume you've already sorted my payment?

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Furia Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Yes, as agreed.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Ennius Tullus
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Enjoy it while you can. That money won't mean anything once this is over.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Ah, truth be told, the money is just a bonus. The chance to be the one to show you fools the truth... That, my friends, is the real prize.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.speaker: Teumo
dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.text: Anyway, best we all get to work. You have a keystone to find.
The cutscene ends.

dwarven-traitor-hidden-entrance.player: That didn't sound good. I'd better let Attala and Servius know.

dwarven-traitor-climbing-into-the-hole.text: You climb through the hole and find yourself in an old tunne.

dwarven-traitor-climbing-back-through-th.text: You climb through the hole and find yourself back in the basement.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: You're back! Did you find something?

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.player: I did. You were right, Attala. Teumo is the one helping the cultists. He's sent them to Neypotzli to find something he calls an Old One keystone.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: More trouble in Neypotzli? Great! This is just what we need!

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.player: Servius, go to Tal Teklan. If we can't stop them from getting that keystone, they'll have everything they need to enter the crypt. You need to make sure the Queen is ready.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Attala
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: I'll gather some guards and see if we can find Teumo. While I do that, [player name], you should go to Neypotzli and find the cultists.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-servius-or-at.text: Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-galna-on-the-.speaker: Galna
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-galna-on-the-.text: Thank you for that drink, human. Please do stay as long as you want!

dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.speaker: Highlord Katlo
dwarven-traitor-talking-to-highlord-katl.text: Ah, good day to you, human. I hear from Attala that you have urgent business in Neypotzli. Don't let me keep you.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Welcome back, iknil. You have timed your arrival here well, for Neypotzli is in danger once more. There are interlopers present who have little regard for the dangers posed by the Moons of Peril.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: Well, that's exactly why I'm here. I know who these interlopers are and I know what they're after.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Yes, I suspected that to be the case. Your arrival was too precise to be coincidence. Tell me, what do the interlopers seek?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: They're after an Old One keystone.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Old One? A curious term. We nagua measure time as the rivers change their paths and as the mountains errode away.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: The days of the masters are fresh memories to me, but to you, one who is so short lived, they are days of myth...

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Tell me, why do the interlopers seek the magic of the masters?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: There's a crypt in the Tlati Rainforest, but it's sealed using Old One magic. These interlopers are cultists who want to get inside. They think they can do so if they have a keystone of their own.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Provided they have the aptitude, I suspect their beliefs are correct.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: Then we need to stop them before they get one.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: The icosahedron behind me is a form of keystone, and the interlopers have already tried to tamper with it.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Yes, but the danger remains. There is another keystone here. An earlier form of the icosahedron from when Neypotzli was being built.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: However, the Moons of Peril must remain my priority. I cannot stop the interlopers from trying to obtain it.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: Don't worry, I can deal with them. I just need to know where they are.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: I can give you a fragment of the icosahedron. It resonates with the magic of the other keystone. It will guide you to it. Go to the keystone, and you will no doubt find the interlopers.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: Thank you, but before I go, there's one other thing...

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: What is it?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: The reason these cultists want to enter that crypt... It's because they think there's a path to Mokhaiotl inside.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Mokhaiotl?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.player: Do you know what it is?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: The masters were always secretive, especially towards the end. They rarely spoke of the world outside this place, but when they did, they only spoke of pain.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: They had already lost so much by the time they summoned me. Their extinction was already guaranteed, yet they kept going all the same.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: This word... Mokhaiotl... I only heard it once, when things neared the end. It was not clear to me what it was, but when they spoke of it... it was the first time I'd heard them speak with hope.
Eyatlalli gives you a keystone fragment.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Now, I must return to my focus on the Moons of Peril. Seek me out in the chamber to the south east if you need my guidance. Go with haste, iknil. Good luck.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Yes, iknil?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: It resonates with the magic of the other keystone. It will guide you to it. You must go there and find the interlopers. They must be removed from Neypotzli.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.speaker: Eyatlalli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-entering-n.text: Good luck, iknil.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-jess.speaker: Jessamine
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-jess.text: Nilsal, [player name]. There were a pair of strange people poking around earlier. That nagua had to come and scare them off.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-jess.player: Yes, I know about them. Don't worry, I'll make sure they don't cause any more problems.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-jess.speaker: Jessamine
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-jess.text: Glad to hear it. I'd hate for them to go damaging something around here!

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 1
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Good to see you again, mate.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.player: Good to see you both as well. How's things?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 2
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Pretty good, mate. There was a little commotion in here earlier, but things soon got straightened out.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 1
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Aye, that nagua ain't to be messed with. She soon dealt with the troublemakers.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 2
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Makes you wonder why someone would try to mess with her in the first place.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 1
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Aye, they must have had some pretty strong convictions to take on that risk. Ain't it crazy how far some people will go?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 2
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Too right. Glad I'm not one of them. I'll just stick to my attempts at being a top-notch builder, thank you very much.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 1
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Anyway, mate, look at us getting you all sidetracked. Nice of you to drop in, but don't be letting us distract you now.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 2
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Though sometimes a distraction can be a good thing. We're all 'bout efficiency these days, but sometimes it can be good to take a step back.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.player: You make a very good point.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.speaker: Builder 1
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-the-.text: Tell you what, mate, when the opportunity next presents itself, you should kick back and relax. You've earned it.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-the-first-fragm.text: The fragment shakes and rises out of your hand, it them falls back into your palm, now pointing north.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-the-second-frag.text: The fragment shakes and rises out of your hand, it them falls back into your palm, now pointing south.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-the-final-fragm.text: The fragment crumbles in your hand and the dust blows towards a nearby wall, causing a symbol to appear.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: A cutscene starts in which the player teleports into a chamber with a keystone, the Tullus twins, and two cultists: Chimalli and Lucius.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.speaker: Ennius Tullus
interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: Well, look who's here! It's Itzla's little lapdog!

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.player: Call me what you want, but the fun's over. You're not going anywhere with that keystone.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: Lucius casts a teleportation spell, with Metzli arriving shortly.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.speaker: Augur Metzli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: Ah, the outsider. I see you survived your encounter with the nagua.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.player: It will take more than that to kill me.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.speaker: Augur Metzli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: Clearly. It's a shame you've chosen to fight against the truth. One such as yourself would have served us well.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.speaker: Augur Metzli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: Still, no matter. The Final Dawn will soon be upon us, and it will see us all become equal in servitude to our gods.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.speaker: Augur Metzli
interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.text: You two, guide this one to Mictl. Be sure not to underestimate [him/her/them].
Metzli teleports herself, the keystone, and the twins out.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-confronting-the.player: sigh* Alright, let's get this over with...

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: As the cultist dies, Attala arrives in the chamber...

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: There you are, [player name]. That nagua told us how to find you.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.player: Well, I'm sorry to say you missed the fun. They got away, Attala. I wasn't able to stop them in time.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: I see. That's not the only bad news, I'm afraid. We searched the whole city, but couldn't find any trace of Teumo. My guess is he's already left to go join those cultists.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.player: Meaning they now have everything they need to enter the crypt.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: Sounds like you should head to Tal Teklan and report to your Queen then.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.player: Before I go, Attala, I'm guessing we shouldn't expect any help from Cam Torum?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: You know as well as I do, [player name], these cultists are fools. There is no world ending threat here, nor any threat to Cam Torum. This is a human problem. It's for humans to deal with.

interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-upon-defeating-.text: If it's any consolation, I hope you don't die. You're one of the few humans that I don't tire of interacting with. Now, I'd better go report to the Highlord.

options.text: I wasn't able to stop those cultists.

steps.player: I wasn't able to stop those cultists.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: So they now have the keystone? The magic of the masters is not for them.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: Do not apologise, iknil. You still have a chance to stop them.

steps.player: That's true I suppose. I guess on that note, I should get going.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: Good luck, iknil.

options.text: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?

interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-atta.speaker: Attala
interlopers-in-neypotzli-talking-to-atta.text: Hello there, [player name]. What can I do for you?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Well, things were quiet for a while, but then you dug up that Teumo business. The Highlord and the Highseer were both rather unhappy. The Highseer in particular. She now needs to find a new advisor.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Speaking of which, how are things with that cult?

steps.player: We're still working on trying to stop them.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Well, good luck with it. Oh, and try not to cause any problems that might affect us while you do so. The dwarves around here don't need a new reason to hate your kind.

options.text: So how long has Cam Torum been around?

crypt-assault-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
crypt-assault-talking-to-servius.text: The Crypt of Tonali is under attack! The Queen has already gone to help. You should go yourself at once!

crypt-assault-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
crypt-assault-talking-to-servius.text: The crypt is impossible to miss. It's beneath the large temple south east of here. Go, my child! Go with the strength of Ralos!

crypt-assault-talking-to-servius-talking.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
crypt-assault-talking-to-servius-talking.text: [player name], you must go to the Crypt of Tonali and help with the defence. It's beneath the large temple south east of here.

crypt-assault-talking-to-servius-talking.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
crypt-assault-talking-to-servius-talking.text: Go with the strength of Ralos, my child!

crypt-assault-entering-the-temple.text: A cutscene begins in the temple, with Tonali warriors battling against the cultists.

crypt-assault-entering-the-temple.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-temple.text: Hold the line! We must not let them get to those doors!

crypt-assault-entering-the-temple.speaker: Captain Vibia
crypt-assault-entering-the-temple.text: Adventurer, about time you showed up! Hold them back! If we let too many defenders fall, nothing will stop those cultists getting through!

crypt-assault-fighting-the-cultists-init.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-fighting-the-cultists-init.text: Defend the warriors, [player name]! We can't let too many fall!

crypt-assault-fighting-the-cultists-afte.text: The player returns outside the Crypt of Tonali.
You failed to defend the crypt from the Emissaries.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: A cutscene begins.
Multiple cultists begin to enter and attack.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Do not let them through!
Metzli, the Tullus twins, Prince Itzla, and Teumo arrive.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: It's time!
Teumo casts a spell to open the doors, and the group enters.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Mother...

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Get him to safety! Ensure he's unharmed!
Prince Itzla is escorted to safety.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Now, let's get after them!
Beyond the doors, the Tullus twins are left behind.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: She's gone, Ennius! Don't you see? We've been abandoned!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Ennius Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: She would not abandon us! We are her gods!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Gods?! My dear brother, how are you this much of a fool?

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Ennius Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Don't tell me now that you deny our destiny?! After all that we've done... you now decide that you don't believe?

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Now? Ennius, I never believed!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Ennius Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Then what was it all for?!
The player, Captain Vibia, and Queen Zyanyi arrive.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Yes, Furia, what was it for? You betrayed your people. You betrayed your Queen. Why?

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Why? Because it was you who betrayed your people! You destroyed everything we stood for when you decided to open our kingdom! You are not worthy of the throne!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.player: So Metzli promised the throne to you instead? Is that it? Seems like that's not going so well.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Ennius Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: You lied to me, Furia!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: I was creating a future for us, brother!

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: And now that future is at an end. Come quietly. Metzli has abandoned you. You have nowhere left to run.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Ennius Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: So you can parade us in front of the people before you put us out of our misery? No. This ends here.
Ennius pulls out a blade.

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Furia Tullus
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: Ennius...

crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-clearing-the-waves-of.text: So be it. Kill them both.
The cutscene ends with Ennius casting several fire spells around the area.

crypt-assault-fighting-ennius.text: While empowering himself for the enrage phase:

steps.speaker: Ennius Tullus
steps.text: The sun burns within me!

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: A cutscene begins.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Such a waste.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: What happened to Furia?

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Captain Vibia
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Forgive me, my Queen. She was injured, but she managed to escape down into the caverns.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.player: And Metzli's still down there as well. This isn't over yet.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Prince Itzla, now decked out in his usual attire, arrives.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: My Queen.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Itzla? What are you doing here? Why aren't you resting?

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: I heard Metzli got away. I'm here to help.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Absolutely not!

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Mother... This is my burden to bear. Let me finish this.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: We've only just got you back, and you want me to send you after her?

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: You were going to go yourself, even though they need you up here. Why you and not me?

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: That's...

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: sigh*

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: [player name], keep my fool of a son alive, would you?

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Go, the both of you, before I change my mind.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Thank you, my Queen.
The player and Prince Itzla prepare to descend.

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Itzla... [player name]...

crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-killing-ennius.text: Be careful down there. May the sun light your way.
The cutscene ends.

crypt-assault-upon-entering-the-southern.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-entering-the-southern.text: Nagua! I'll deal with them. You go on ahead. Don't worry, I'll catch up.

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: If Prince Itzla Arkan is in combat with an Earthen Nagua:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'll deal with these nagua, iknami. You go on ahead.

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: If Prince Itzla Arkan is not in combat with an Earthen Nagua:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: There's a lot of nagua around here. I'll deal with them, iknami. You go on ahead. Don't worry, I'll catch up.

crypt-assault-upon-venturing-to-the-area.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-venturing-to-the-area.text: Look at this place, iknami! This is incredible!.

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: Can you believe this place was down here all this time? We had no idea!

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.player: You never knew all this was right underneath one of your holy sites?

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: Well... sort of, I suppose. We always knew the crypt was originally built by the Old Ones, but we had no idea how far all of this stretched. It's not like anyone was ever allowed to come down here and check!

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: Anyway, there hasn't been any sign of Metzli or Furia, but they must have come this way. Let's have a look around and see if we can find a way forward.

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.player: Any thoughts on where to start?

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: Well, we seem to have more of these strange teleport tiles here... Maybe we should see where they lead?
If none of the chambers have been completed:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: There hasn't been any sign of Metzli or Furia, but they must have come this way. Let's have a look around and see if we can find a way forward.

options.text: Any thoughts on where to start?

crypt-assault-talking-to-prince-itzla-ar.text: If one of the chambers has been completed:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We're making progress. Let's keep it up.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, we managed to activate a statue in one of these rooms. My guess is we now need to activate the one in the other.

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-talking-to-pri.text: If the player has not yet imbued the altars successfully at least once:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: This room is fascinating...

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-talking-to-pri.text: If the player has imbued the altars successfully at least once:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I think we're making progress, [player name].

options.text: Any ideas on what to do?

steps.player: Any ideas on what to do?

steps.text: If the player has not yet imbued the altars successfully at least once:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, we've got another one of those statues, and these altars around the edges also look important. The layout of the room seems quite specific as well. It's almost like a compass, or maybe even a clock!

steps.player: A clock? But there's only eight points.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: True, but maybe the Old Ones used a different kind of clock to us...
If the player has imbued the altars successfully at least once:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, this thing we're doing with the altars seems to be working, so I say we just keep doing that.

options.text: Can you translate something for me?
options.condition: If the player has inspected the Sun Statue:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Of course, iknami! What do you need translating?
Enter a word for Itzla to translate:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Oma? I think that means two.
Translation: Oma - Two

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Naui? This is the one I struggle with. It might mean four.**** {{mes|Translation: Naui - Four}}

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Kuli? I think that means five.
Translation: Kuli - Five

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Chaki? I think that means six.
Translation: Chaki - Six

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Koma? I think that means seven.
Translation: Koma - Seven

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ueai? I think that means eight.
Translation: Ueai - Eight

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Makti? I think that means ten.
Translation: Makti - Ten

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Hmm... I'm not too sure on that one.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Very funny, [player name].

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'll give it a go.

options.text: Thanks! I'm done translating for now.

steps.player: Thanks! I'm done translating for now.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Hopefully it helps in some way, iknami.

options.text: Can you go to an altar for me?
options.condition: If the player has interacted with an altar:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Of course, iknami! Just tell me which one.

steps.prompt: Which altar do you want Itzla to move to?

steps.text: If Itzla is not currently standing near the chosen altar:
Prince Itzla Arkan runs to the selected altar:
If Itzla is already at the chosen altar:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm already at that altar, [player name]. Is there another you want me to move to?

options.text: What do you make of this essence I found?
options.condition: If the player has Kuhu essence in their inventory from searching an urn and not yet imbued the altars successfully at least once:

steps.player: What do you make of this essence I found?

steps.text: You show the essence to Itzla.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Hmm... It looks similar to the altars around the room. Where did you find it?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, I doubt it was left here by accident...

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'll be here, iknami.

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-inspecting-the.text: Light reflects off the statue, revealing some words engraved upon it: [Old Ones text]

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-imbuing-an-alt.text: If the player does not have any Kuhu essence:

steps.text: You have nothing to imbue the altar with.

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-imbuing-an-alt.text: If the player has Kuhu essence:

steps.text: If the player imbues the altar successfully, and it does not complete the chamber:
You imbue the altar, and hear a grinding sound coming from the central statue.
Only the first time:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: That seemed to do the trick! Keep it up.
If the player imbues the altar successfully, and it completes the chamber:
You imbue the altar and the central statue lights up with energy.
If the player does not imbue the altar successfully:
You imbue the altar, but it doesn't seem to work.

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-searching-an-u.text: If there is essence in the urn:

steps.text: You find some strange essence inside the urn.

crypt-assault-sun-chamber-searching-an-u.text: If there is not essence in the urn:

steps.text: The urn appears to be empty.

crypt-assault-moon-chamber-talking-to-pr.text: If the player hasn't moved Itzla yet:

steps.text: If it's the first time speaking to him:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah, the teleporter seems to have separated us.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, I might still be able to be of use from here. These look like pressure plates. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.
If the player has already spoken to him:

steps.player: Any idea what we should be doing here?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, these look like pressure plates where I am. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.

steps.player: Any idea what that 'some way' might be?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm not really sure. Those braziers around the room look like they could be important though.

steps.player: Alright, I'll see if I can work something out.

crypt-assault-moon-chamber-talking-to-pr.text: If the player has moved Itzla and not yet placed the kindling successfully at least once:

steps.player: Any idea what we should be doing here?

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, it seems I can use these pressure plates to help you get past the fires. Beyond that, I'm not too sure. Those braziers around the room look like they could be important though.

steps.player: Alright, I'll see if I can work something out.

crypt-assault-moon-chamber-talking-to-pr.text: If the player has placed the kindling successfully at least once:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: We seem to be making progress, [player name]. Keep it up.

crypt-assault-moon-chamber-moving-prince.text: If Itzla is already at the tile being clicked:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm already there, [player name].

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: There looks to be a small amount of burnt kindling around the statue.
If the player does not have root kindling:
If the player has one root kindling:

steps.prompt: Place some kindling on the statue?

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: If the player has more than one root kindling:

steps.text: How much kindling do you want to place on the statue? (1-X)
If the player places the correct amount of root kindling:
The statue seems to glow as it accepts your offering of kindling.
If placing the kindling does not complete the chamber, only the first time:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Whatever you're doing seems to be working. Keep at it!
If placing the kindling completes the chamber:
The statue lights up with energy as it accepts your offering of kindling.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Nice work, [player name]! I think you did it!
If the player places the incorrect amount of root kindling:
The statue rejects the kindling and incinerates it.

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You pull up some roots.

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: If the player has space in their inventory:

steps.text: You need some space in your inventory to do that.

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.text: You search the tools and find an old knife blade.

crypt-assault-standing-on-a-tile-where-a.text: If the player has space in their inventory:

steps.text: You search the tools and find an old knife blade, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I think that's us done here. I guess we should take a look at that room on the other side now.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I think that's us done here. I guess we should see if we can progress further into these ruins now.

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.player: What do you think we'll find on the other side?

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.text: If all goes well, we find Metzli and Furia and we show them the error of their ways. No doubt they won't be willing to hear reason, so I suspect it will get a touch violent in the process...

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.text: But then, once that's done, maybe we go and have a nice drink somewhere. I know I need one.

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.player: A drink does sound nice, it's just...
That nagua... I keep thinking about what she said about Mokhaiotl being an archive. What does that mean? Could this place be what she was referring to?

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.text: Hmm... Well, I guess there's only one way to find out... Shall we?
The player and Prince Itzla both stand on the pressure plates.
The player and Prince Itzla both stomp on the pressure plates, opening the doors.

crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-opening-the-final-doors.text: They can't be too far ahead now. Let's find them, [player name].

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: This ends here, Metzli. No more running.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: Running? What do you think I'm running from? After all this time, I'm finally right where I need to be.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: And where's that exactly? Another Old One ruin? That's all this place is. There's no centre of the world here. Face it, Metzli, you've failed. Your Final Dawn has failed.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: The Final Dawn? Don't you see? There never was a Final Dawn. There never will be a Final Dawn.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.player: You lied to the Emissaries? Why?

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: Why? Quite simply because they let me.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: Mad? Of course I'm mad! So many see madness as a weakness... As a burden. But to do what I do... To seek what I seek... Insanity is the only way one can ever walk that path.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: The people of this land... Their lives are built upon the truths presented to them. Ralos... Ranul... They put their faith in the gods they are told to believe in.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: From their first cries to their dying breaths, every choice they make is built upon those foundations. Foundations that have become so ingrained, that no sane person would ever question them.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: You have some, like the Emissaries, who dance on the edge of madness, but never leap into its embrace.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: It was never truth that they sought. They just took comfort in someone telling them what they wanted to hear.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: And so it falls to me. We stand here in Mokhaiotl, the last archive of the Old Ones. When their doom befell them, they did not pray, they preserved.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: They housed their collective knowledge, their collective power, right here. For years it's sat waiting... Waiting for a worthy inheritor. Waiting... for me.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: Here, today, I will shatter the foundations that the sane never question. I will uncover the realities they shy away from. And in my madness, I will finally deliver that which the world has forgotten.

crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-confronting-metzli.text: Today, I will be the one to finally find the truth.
Augur quickly transforms into her ranged combat gear.

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: It's pitiful how blind you are! Can't you see that everything we've been taught is built on a lie?!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Look at this place! The truth is staring you in the face, but even now you fight against it!

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Ralos? Ranul? Everything we thought we knew... It came from the Old Ones! It came from here!

crypt-assault-fighting-metzli.text: At the start of the enrage phase:

steps.speaker: Augur Metzli
steps.text: Enough! This ends now!

crypt-assault-fighting-metzli.text: If hit during the enrage phase, only the first time:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Keep moving, [player name]!

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.text: A cutscene starts, in which Metzli is down on one knee.

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.text: Never! I've fought too hard for this!

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.player: Look around, Metzli. This place is empty. Whatever 'truth' you're looking for, it's clearly not here.

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.text: No! I won't let you stop me now!
Metzli unleashes a blast of flames, knocking the player and Prince Itzla back. She then transforms back into her regular clothing.

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli.text: She's injured. She won't be going far. Let's get after her.

crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli-talk.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-defeating-metzli-talk.text: Metzli won't get far now she's injured. Let's find her.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: Of course there's nothing here, Metzli. What were you expecting? Did you think Ralos himself was going to pop out and share the secrets of the world with you?

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Augur Metzli
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: But the Old Ones... This was their archive... Their gift...

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: And yet it's empty. Perhaps this 'gift' was never meant for us. Or maybe it never existed at all. Either way, there's no 'truth' to be found here. Looks like we'll just have to keep making our own.
Furia Tullus appears from the entrance.
Furia launches a throwing knife toward Metzli, killing her.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: Well... I suppose that's that then.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: We'd better take Furia here to my mother. She'll be the one who decides what happens to her.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: Furia, come with us, and don't even think about trying anything.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.player: You go on ahead. I want to take a look around first. I'll catch up with you.

crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-entering-the-archive.text: Fair enough. Don't take too long.

crypt-assault-chamber-entrance-interacti.text: The statue has a single word engraved upon it: 'Ralos'
The statue has a single word engraved upon it: 'Ranul'
You go to return to the chamber where you found Metzli, but hear a horrifying screeching sound coming from within. You decide it's probably best to remain here.

crypt-assault-searching-a-skeleton.text: You search the skeleton and find a tablet.

crypt-assault-upon-interacting-with-the-.text: If the player has not read the tablet found near the entrance:
If the player has read the tablet found near the entrance:

steps.text: The screen shakes, and a screeching sound echoes.
You go to return to the chamber where you found Metzli, but hear a horrifying screeching sound coming from within. You decide it's probably best to remain here.
Having discovered all that you can in the ruins, you return to the crypt...

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Having discovered all that you can in the ruins, you return to the crypt...

The screen fades to black, then fades back to the first room in the crypt, where you fought alongside the Queen. Fires and fallen soldiers litter the room, with some survivors walking about. Next to you stands Furia, tied. Itzla, the Queen, and Captain Vibia stand ahead of you.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Ah, there you are, [player name].

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: So it's done?

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: It's done. Metzli is dead. This one here is all that remains.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Take her to the capital. Find a nice cell for her where she can await her fate.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: If I may, mother... Metzli and Ennius are already dead. The Emissaries are now without leaders and are unlikely to be much of a threat.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: But?

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: But there are still many out there who supported them. As far as they're concerned, we've already made two martyrs today. It might be prudent for us to keep Furia alive.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: I see...

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: [player name].

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: My son is showing a remarkable amount of restraint and foresight. The cultists didn't replace him with an imposter, did they?

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.player: No, I think it's definitely him.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Then consider me impressed. We might make a king out of you yet.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Thank you, my Queen.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Now, I must return to the capital. I need to see to arrangements around a new Teokan. [player name]. Itzla. Well done. Timoiva for now, and may the sun light your way.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Captain Vibia
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Move!
The Queen and Vibia depart for Fortis, taking Furia with them.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Well, that was quite the adventure.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.player: Yes, nice of you to show up right at the end. Trust you to skip all the hard work.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Tetamo! I was working very hard, thank you very much. I was conducting essential research on our enemy from the last place they'd expect!

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.player: Is that so? Well, I'm sure you made many useful discoveries.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Indeed I did, iknami. Speaking of which, did you discover anything of note down in the ruins?

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.player: Yes and no. It seems Metzli was right in a way. Mokhaiotl was meant to be an Old One archive. Thing is, they never finished it. Something killed the ones working on it while it was still being built.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Interesting... All this time we've thought of Mokhaiotl as the centre of the world, and yet it was something else entirely. Makes you wonder what else it is that we don't know...

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Still, I guess it doesn't really matter. Metzli fooled herself into thinking that she could find all the answers, yet the beauty of this world is that we are free to look upon it as we desire.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: But enough about Metzli. I have something far more important to talk about.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: While I know you of course needed no convincing to put your life at risk to rescue me, it feels only right to show my thanks by giving you a little something.
If the player has a full inventory:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Ah, but I see you don't have space for it right now. Come back when you do.

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Itzla holds out his sword.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: This blade once belonged to my grandfather, but I believe its path now lies with you.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: And I can't think of anyone more deserving to wield it, iknami. Now, I'd best return to the palace. Timoiva, my friend, and may the sun light your way.
Quest complete!

crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
crypt-assault-upon-fully-exploring-the-a.text: Nilsal, [player name]. As I was saying, it feels only right for me to show my thanks to you by giving you a little something.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, now that the local cult of murderers is no longer trying to kill me or my father, I'd say things are looking up.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm also finding I've got a bit more time on my hands now that things are all sorted. I suggested to mother I spend that time in the Colosseum. I don't know if she was totally convinced.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Anyway, I won't keep you, iknami. I'm sure you've got plenty more adventures to go on. Timoiva, my friend.

options.text: You don't happen to have another sword do you?

steps.player: You don't happen to have another sword do you?

steps.text: If the player lost the Arkan blade:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Well, iknami, as luck would have it, someone came along trying to sell a sword that perfectly matches the one I gave you. He claimed he just found it on the ground!

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Indeed. I'm sure it can't be the same one. After all, that was a one of a kind family heirloom, so you'd definitely have taken good care of it.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Anyway, I had to pay 250,000 coins to buy this one, so if you want it, that's how much I'll have to charge you.
If the player does not have enough money:

steps.player: Ah, I don't have enough. I'll be back shortly.

steps.text: If the player has enough money:

steps.prompt: Pay 250,000 coins for the Arkan Blade?

steps.text: You give Itzla 250,000 coins and he gives you the Arkan Blade in return.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Use it well, iknami.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: As you wish, iknami.
If the player has the Arkan blade somewhere stored:

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: I'm afraid not, iknami. You'll have to go and find where you left the one I gave you. I'm sure you won't have lost it. After it, it's a one of a kind family heirloom.

steps.player: Right... yes... I'll go see if I can find it.

steps.speaker: Prince Itzla Arkan
steps.text: Timoiva, my friend.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.text: Nilsal, [player name]. It is good to see you.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.player: Likewise, my Queen. How have things been since the Emissaries were dealt with?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.text: Well, with the cult out of the way, we've been able to refocus on the recent opening of the kingdom. Signing the treaties was only the first step.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.text: There are new opportunities for us in areas such as trade that we're still yet to fully explore.
If A Kingdom Divided has not been completed:

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them, but my hope is that will change soon.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.text: If A Kingdom Divided has been completed:

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: Then of course you have Kourend. The complicated history between our kingdoms means we are yet to sign a treaty with them.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: I was hoping to arrange one with their new king, but his reign turned out to be a rather short one. I must confess, I find the continued instability up there to be concerning.

steps.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
steps.text: We will have to see how their new king fares. He is young and inexperienced, but he may still have potential...

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.speaker: Queen Zyanyi Arkan
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-queen-zya.text: Anyway, if there's nothing else, I'm afraid I must return to my work. May the sun light your way, [player name].

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: Nilsal, my child. It is good to see you.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: Well, it is relieving to know that my life is no longer in danger, but there is no shortage of work to be done.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: The Sect of Ranul are planning a special Gathering to select their new Teokan, and we in the Church of Ralos have an important part to play. There is a lot to prepare.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.player: Given what happened in the crypt, I'm guessing things will be a bit different this time as well.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: Indeed. For a start, the doors within the crypt seem to be beyond repair, meaning the ceremony will need some substantial changes.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: It does also mean that anyone can now access the caverns below, which reminds me, Itzla told me what you found down there.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.player: Yes, Mokhaiotl. Not quite the centre of the world after all.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: Well, I'd be careful of making assumptions, my child. Itzla said the ruins were meant to be an archive. A centre point for all the knowledge of the Old Ones.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: I'd say it makes perfect sense that they'd choose to name a place like that after Mokhaiotl.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.player: I suppose I hadn't considered that possibility.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.speaker: Servius, Teokan of Ralos
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-servius.text: Well, being the Teokan of Ralos, I do have the odd moment of wisdom from time to time. Now, I must get back to my work. Timoiva, my child, and may the sun light your way.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.speaker: Attala
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.text: Hello there, [player name]. I hear that cultist business of yours ended up getting sorted. Your Queen traded Teumo with the Highlord in return for a new mineral deal.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.speaker: Attala
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.text: On that topic, I'm going to guess that they didn't end up finding the centre of the world?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.player: Not exactly, though they did find something. It seems that Mokhaiotl was actually meant to be an Old One archive, though it was never finished.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.speaker: Attala
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.text: Ah, so once again you humans managed to misinterpret something the Old Ones left behind. Some things never change.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.speaker: Attala
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-in.text: Anyway, was there something you wanted?

options.text: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
Not really. I'd better get going.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-su.speaker: Attala
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-attala-su.text: Hello there, [player name]. What can I do for you?

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Well, things were quiet for a while, but then you dug up that Teumo business. The Highlord and the Highseer were both rather unhappy. The Highseer in particular. She now needs to find a new advisor.

steps.speaker: Attala
steps.text: Still, at least the world didn't end. Hard to imagine that some of you humans actually considered that a possibility! Your kind never change.

options.text: So how long has Cam Torum been around?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.speaker: Eyatlalli
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.text: Welcome back, iknil. Were you able to deal with those interlopers?

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.player: Yes. They won't be a problem again.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.speaker: Eyatlalli
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.text: That is good to hear. The Moons of Peril already pose so great a threat. Neypotzli does not need any more dangers.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.player: I thought you'd want to know as well that they did find Mokhaiotl. It turns out it was meant to be an archive.
Somewhere to house the collective knowledge of the Old Ones. Thing is, it was never finished. Something happened that stopped them from doing so.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.speaker: Eyatlalli
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.text: I see... The masters always hoped that humans and dwarves would be their inheritors. Mokhaiotl must have been part of that. To hear that it never came to be is... unfortunate.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.speaker: Eyatlalli
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.text: It is alright, iknil. Time is like a river. You can try to change the current, but in the end, it always reaches the sea. Some things are simply not meant to be.

post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.speaker: Eyatlalli
post-quest-dialogue-talking-to-eyatlalli.text: Now, let us speak of something else.

options.text: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
I wanted to ask you about your masters.

steps.player: I wanted to ask you about your masters.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: What do you wish to know?

steps.player: I guess anything really. I still know so little about them.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: If your hope is that I can tell you about a whole race, then I am likely to disappoint you, iknil. The masters were secretive individuals. They rarely divulged information that I did not require.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: All I can tell you about are the three individuals that I knew personally.

steps.player: That's still something. What were they like?

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: They were kind, but filled with sadness. As you know, they summoned me after another of their kind unleashed the Moons of Peril.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: It was a dark time. Their people had suffered great calamity years earlier and their extinction was inevitable.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: It seems that many, such as the shaman who summoned the Moons, felt that the only salvation left was destruction.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: My masters, however, felt differently. They fought for a world that was no longer their own. They believed in preserving these lands for those who would inhabit them afterwards.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: Yes. Humans and dwarves were recent arrivals here, but the masters saw you as inheritors. I believe in some ways, you offered them hope in a time filled with pain.

steps.player: I see. Than you for sharing that with me.

steps.speaker: Eyatlalli
steps.text: It is not a problem, iknil.

options.text: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?

steps.speaker: Emissary
steps.text: Another group left earlier. Without the Augur to guide them, they are lost.

steps.speaker: Emissary
steps.text: The Augur may be gone, but we remain. We must stay true to her teachings.

steps.speaker: Emissary
steps.text: I can't believe the Augur is gone. I really thought she would lead us to the Final Dawn.

steps.speaker: Emissary
steps.text: We become more fractured by the day. Earlier I heard someone claiming that Ennius and Furia weren't actually Ralos and Ranul reborn at all!
